I had an appointment to see the doctor (I forgot his name) as my chest is tight (still tight as I am writing this), as I have severe asthma and it flares up when I have a cold and sore throat. I have been unwell since Saturday (today is Wednesday) and still feel no better (hence why i got an appointment).

The doctor saw me and when I told him how I was feeling (tight chested and struggling to talk and could not walk much without feeling very tired and breathless), he took my oxygen stats (which i did tell him that im not a normal asthmatic as I dont wheeze, have a clear chest when you listen to it and have good oxygen stats) but still have a tight chest. After taking my stats he said that if I had a tight chest and struggling to breathe then my stats should be low, but because they are not it sounds like i could be having an anxiety attack??
I told the doctor im not anxious about anything and quite relaxed (other than being unwell and struggling to breathe and talk), then he said maybe ive been misdiagnosed with asthma (which is rubbish as ive had asthma and been in an out of hospital over 200 times with it)! Then he even accused me of maybe faking it! How dare he!!!

Not once did he ask me about my history (which if he even looked or had access to my files he would of seen how many times ive been in hospital, how many tests ive had and had lung collapse in the past)!

I will be looking at making a complaint against the negligence of this doctor, as he clearly couldn't be bothered to help me feel better (which is his job role)!

Too many times ive seen (both through experience and reading on the news) where doctors dont do their jobs and the patien gets worse and either dies or nearly dies.

To be struggling to breathe and barely having the energy or oxygen to talk and to be just treated this way is a disgrace and very dangerous (luckily im used to this with incompetent doctors who dont read my history so I dont panic).

I will warn any asthmatic peerson to stay away from this surgery as they will treat you like a text book (when not all asthmatics are the same) and could seriously put your life in
